summary: This bill amends the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 to allow federal funds to be used for K-12 student instruction and teacher professional development on the safe, effective, and responsible use of artificial intelligence.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Elementary and Secondary Education Act to allow existing funds to be used for artificial intelligence curricula and professional development for educators. This expands the scope of what public schools can spend money on, indicating more spending on public schools for AI-related education.
